summaries.Romania: Russia escalated hybrid warfare against Romania with a coordinated sabotage network targeting the Carfil defense factory, prompting swift government condemnation and security measures. Meanwhile, PM Niculescu made his first official visit to Moldova to strengthen bilateral ties and coordinate responses to Russian threats.
summaries.Healthcare: Personalized medicine is accelerating with FDA pathways for gene therapies and cancer vaccines reaching patients, while healthcare systems face persistent staffing crises and payer pressures threatening service delivery.
summaries.Tech: Apple released M6-powered iMac and MacBook Pro with no price increases despite spec bumps, while Anthropic's IPO filing revealed existential AI risks and Amazon's massive ownership stake in the AI company.

items.title: Opinion: Cancer vaccines are finally here. How do we get them to patients?
items.snippet: “If we want cancer vaccines to reach patients faster than BRCA testing did, there are several challenges to address now,” write Karen E. Knudsen and Othman Laraki.
items.line: Cancer vaccines have arrived clinically; addressing distribution and access challenges is now critical to realizing their public health potential.

items.title: Anthropic lays out drug R&D ambitions, risks in mammoth IPO filing

items.line: Anthropic's IPO filing reveals the company is building molecular biology labs and pursuing drug discovery, expanding AI's role in biotech.

items.title: New M6 Macs buck Apple’s second wave of price hikes

items.line: Apple's M6 MacBook Pro and iMac maintain pricing despite significant spec upgrades, reversing the company's recent pattern of price increases.
